doc.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

title: Fishing, the boathouse and a boat accident
summary: Pete talks about fishing and his boathouse; they joke about a boating mishap in which Eddie broke two ribs.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And fishing. You like to fish, don't you? Oh, yeah. Lately, I haven't had too much time to get on my boat to go out fishing. But one love I have is fishing in my boathouse. My wife and I really enjoy it out there. I have a pool table there where we can just get away from everything. Get away from the phone.
You take the band out sometimes.
Right. Part of the band. Well, when they trust my skipper in the...
Well, I understand one time that you made a bad move and the trumpet section fell on Eddie. Is that right? That wasn't Pete. That was somebody else. I have to say that.
No, we went fishing out there. That wasn't my boat. No. No. It wasn't my... You weren't badly hurt. I broke two ribs. Oh, really? Yeah. I didn't know that. And his bottle. That was in the top coat.
